description: Policy for the Guardian's proposed Claude Code hooks. Edit this file to loosen or tighten a rule; the scripts hold no policy of their own. Changing it is an R2 action (Preflight Brief).
protected_paths_note: Paths are relative to the repository root. A trailing slash means everything below. The poster's data (bloor-assets/) is deliberately NOT listed, so maintenance sessions can still edit the queue. The workflow file is listed because a changed workflow can read the repository's secrets.
safe_delete_note: Recursive deletes are allowed only below these folders (and never the folder itself).
block_external_writes_note: curl or wget with a non-GET method or an upload body is an external-facing action (R4) and needs a Preflight Brief first.
publish_roots_note: gh may post a file's text (--body-file, -F body=@file, --input) only if it is inside the repository or one of these folders, is not a credential or protected file, and the secret scanner finds nothing in it.
